title: virtiofs direct empty write may publish a larger local size without a server write
mechanism: VirtioFsInode::direct_write_at commits local metadata with max(old_size, offset + written) even when do_direct_write returned 0 for an empty reader without sending FUSE_WRITE, raising the cached size, sector estimate, mtime and ctime.
contract: A zero-length write to a regular file returns 0 without any other effect (write(2)).
observed: Source only: the direct path commits a local size of max(old_size, offset) plus new timestamps after an empty write, with no server write. Syscall visibility is unconfirmed.

repro.how_to_run: No reproducer. finding.md Reproduction describes an O_DIRECT zero-length pwrite at 8192 on a 2-byte virtiofs file, with cached-route and Linux controls.

caveats: Static only. Attribute refresh may mask syscall observations, and remote growth is not established. Runtime NOT_RUN, upstream dedup NOT_CHECKED. Keep separate from AST-02 and AST-14.
